sections.title: The Professoriate: Foundations, Careers, and Current Issues
sections.description: The goal for this course is to introduce students to the world of academia, with a particular emphasis on the U.S. professoriate. We will review the early beginnings and formation of the academic profession, examine critical junctures in academic careers such as graduate student socialization, hiring, tenure, and teaching, and discuss current issues facing the academy. Those interested in exploring a career in academia are encouraged to enroll.
